title: The finest detail each satellite could see in the microwave background
description: Bar chart on a logarithmic scale. The width of each satellite's beam, in minutes of arc, at its sharpest frequency: COBE's Differential Microwave Radiometer (launched 1989), 7 degrees, or 420 arcminutes; WMAP (2001), 13.2 arcminutes at 94 GHz; Planck (2009), 5 arcminutes at 217 GHz and above. Smaller is sharper. Data: Wikipedia's Cosmic Background Explorer, Wilkinson Microwave Anisotropy Probe and Planck (spacecraft).
heading: BEAM WIDTH · ARCMINUTES · LOG SCALE
